hearthbay-two-movements.a.prompt:
Instrumental soundtrack for a cozy fishing-village video game, in two movements that share one melody. No vocals anywhere.

Movement 1, Hearthbay by day (first half, 0:00 to 2:50): a warm, lilting folk tune in D major at a steady 96 BPM in 6/8. Fingerpicked nylon-string guitar plays a simple, hummable eight-bar melody; a concertina answers with soft swells and takes the melody on repeats; soft upright bass on the downbeats; no drums. Every few bars a slightly detuned music box doubles a phrase of the melody and lands on one subtly wrong note, a small uncanny touch under the coziness. Steady and unhurried, like a loop, no build-up.

Movement 2, Hearthbay by night (second half, 2:50 to 5:40): the same eight-bar melody at a much slower pace, about 60 BPM, sparse and hushed. A celesta plays the melody alone over a low sustained drone from bowed bass and harmonium; long pauses between phrases; a few distant guitar harmonics; the detuned music box returns once or twice with its wrong note. Calm, lonely, slightly mysterious. Ends quietly without a big finish.

gull-point.a.prompt: Instrumental ambient mystery cue for a lighthouse on a foggy headland at night, for a video game. Very sparse and slow, no steady beat. Deep foghorn-like low brass and bowed-bass swells rise and fade every ten seconds or so; between them, glassy bell tones and bowed crystal-bowl notes ring out and decay into long reverb; a faint cold airy pad underneath; an occasional single low piano note. Eerie but beautiful, patient, lots of space. No vocals, no drums, no resolving melody. The same even texture from start to finish so it can loop.

sting-quest.a.prompt: A three-second musical sting for completing a quest in a cozy fishing game: nylon-string guitar and concertina play one bright rising four-note flourish in D major, a soft glockenspiel sparkle lands on the last note, which rings out warmly. sting-rare.a.prompt: A three-second eerie shimmer sting for catching a rare, strange fish in a cozy mystery game: a glassy bowed-crystal swell with shimmering detuned chimes and a high celesta figure that hangs unresolved, then fades.
